proof_body:
by
  intro T _ f n _
  simp only [fourierCoeff, smul_eq_mul, neg_neg]
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self (fun t => fourier n t * f t)]
  congr 1
  funext t
  congr 1
  rw [fourier_apply, fourier_apply]
  congr 2
  simp
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : AddCircle T → ℂ) (n : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f AddCircle.haarAddCircle → fourierCoeff (fun x => f (-x)) n = fourierCoeff f (-n)
